name: Charles Goerens - § 39
title: REPORT on financing for development – ahead of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development in Seville
part_text: Underlines the lack of transparency regarding the functioning of the Global Gateway in EU partner countries and absence of clear mechanisms for assessing its impact, particularly in fragile contexts where the Global Gateway may not apply; emphasises that there must be a continuous evaluation of the Global Gateway to assess its effectiveness and strategic direction;
